industry_finding.reason: Managed operations and cloud migration for large enterprises are supported. The Azure offering modernizes large-enterprise legacy environments but does not establish mainframe modernization specifically. Explicit mainframe replacement evidence is scoped to European SMEs, leaving the mandatory large-enterprise mainframe offering unproven.

company_stage_evidence.quote: SAN RAMON, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Grid Dynamics Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: GDYN) (Grid Dynamics), a premier AI transformation partner for the Fortune 1000, announced today it has entered into a strategic partnership with Doosan Robotics, a global leader in collaborative robot solutions, delivering cutting-edge AI robotics to 45 countries worldwide.

company.intent_details: A press release dated July 16, 2026 says Grid Dynamics entered a strategic partnership with Doosan Robotics, partnering to provide industrial cobot users with a turnkey software stack for physical AI and corresponding integration services. A report dated May 19, 2026 says Grid Dynamics launched AI-native modernization on Azure, targeting larger enterprise deals. This activity may help Grid Dynamics broaden its cloud migration and modernization services.
